The '''Dubrillion Ocean''' was the main ocean of [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]], and the location of the [[Dubrillion superlaser facility]] and the [[Battle of Dubrillion (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Dubrillion]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
